runs.inputMethod: Real Chromium WheelEvents scheduled at source cadence via CDP; touch taps and keyboard via Playwright. No engine/camera responses mocked.

limitations: Chromium software rendering and emulated touch/trackpad input are not physical-device qualification.
Default Earth uses ellipsoid terrain. Non-ORAS observer elevations use identified zero fallback; no terrain datum is qualified.
